server.name: affitor
server.title: Affitor
server.description: Read your Affitor affiliate program from AI tools: partners, commissions, earnings, payouts and billing. Read-only.

protocolMetadata.instructions: Affitor runs affiliate programs. This connection is read-only: it cannot change data or move money. A brand connection sees one program; a partner connection sees only that partner. Money is an integer, in an object keyed by unit (USD_cents, VND_dong) or in a *_cents field next to its currency. Date filters are UTC sale dates, 30 days by default; commission lists cover all dates unless from or to is given. Where an item has a url, it opens that page in the Affitor dashboard; referral links come as short_link and affiliate_url. get_program returns the tracker snippet and how its check works.

tool.name: get_program
tool.title: Get program
tool.description: Read the connected program: profile, status, commission terms, approval mode, partner counts, setup checklist, tracker status with 24-hour counts and the install snippet. Takes no input. tracking.tag unknown means not checked yet. Every item has a url to open it in Affitor. Use to check setup or install tracking; for partners use list_partners, for money get_commission_summary or get_billing.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Affitor to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Affitor to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.affitor.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Affitor MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, Affitor scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Affitor's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, Affitor scores 93/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 7 of 7 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Affitor?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Affitor in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
